faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Bangalore Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Bangalore Research Associate positions is 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate post as per the official notification released by IIM Bangalore.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in management, social sciences, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or Science. A four-year undergraduate program with distinction in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Economics is also considered.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIM Bangalore Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role at IIM Bangalore?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position primarily involves shortlisting of eligible candidates based on their applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIM Bangalore is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIM Bangalore located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore) is located in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a four-year undergraduate degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have completed a four-year undergraduate program with distinction in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Economics are also eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIM Bangalore or via the direct apply link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Research Associate recruitment at IIM Bangalore is IIMB/RA/RECT/2026/53.
